cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I approve discussing my move, report the train time once more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. I've checked five times, and your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Time confirmed. Now tell me whether this ticket is sufficient for the barrier, or whether I need the booking email.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through. Are you scared of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your escort offer is approved, subject to one check: do you need a ticket to get onto the platform? Settle that before we discuss anything else.

reason: A administers repeated travel checks and converts B escort offer into another condition, explicitly displacing the fear question with logistical approval.
